hints.en: Look at the length first: just `"****"` if `len(value) <= 4`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def mask(value):
    if len(value) <= 4:
        return "****"
    return "****" + value[-4:]

print(mask("sk-live-9f3a1a2b"))
print(mask("abcd"))
print(mask(""))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def mask(value):
    if len(value) <= 4:
        return "****"
    return "****" + value[-4:]

print(mask("sk-live-9f3a1a2b"))
print(mask("abcd"))
print(mask(""))
```
